name: Hollow Hill Parade
note: An original stop-motion cast parades past: each character talks, blinks and says their catchphrase.
art_style: Handmade stop-motion animation style: a character sculpted from felt, clay and fabric with visible stitching and soft texture, on a cosy candlelit Halloween storybook set with warm orange, purple and golden light and a softly blurred background. Kid-friendly, cute and gentle, not scary. Square portrait, front-facing, the character looking straight at the viewer with eyes open and mouth closed; the face is centred, with the eyes just above the middle of the picture and the mouth just below it. No text, no letters, no frame, no border.

variants.mouth-mid: Edit this picture. Keep everything exactly the same: same character, same pose, position and size, same background, lighting and colours. Change only the character's mouth: slightly open, as if in the middle of saying a word.
variants.mouth-open: Edit this picture. Keep everything exactly the same: same character, same pose, position and size, same background, lighting and colours. Change only the character's mouth: wide open in a happy 'oh' shape, as if talking excitedly.
variants.blink: Edit this picture. Keep everything exactly the same: same character, same pose, position and size, same background, lighting and colours. Change only the character's eyes: closed, as if blinking.

moon.head: Old Man Moon: a big, round, glowing full moon with a kind, sleepy old face (bushy eyebrows, rosy cheeks, a gentle smile), made of soft cream felt with stitched craters, filling the middle of the picture, hanging in a velvet night sky with tiny stitched stars.
moon.style: a sleepy, kindly old man, warm and slow, like a grandpa telling a bedtime story, with a chuckle in his voice

larry.head: Lantern Larry: a friendly patchwork scarecrow whose head is a round, glowing paper lantern with a cheerful stitched face, straw poking out of his collar, a patched waistcoat, and no hat, standing in a moonlit pumpkin patch.
larry.style: a goofy, cheerful farmhand, upbeat and a little flustered, always laughing at himself

moth.head: Countess Moth: an elegant velvet moth lady with big soft eyes, fluffy antennae, plum-and-gold patterned wings spread out behind her, and a tiny pearl necklace, hovering beside a glowing candle on an old wooden desk.
moth.style: a dramatic, glamorous old-Hollywood diva, swooning and breathless, very theatrical and funny

bones.head: Bartholomew Bones: a short, round, chubby little skeleton sculpted from polished cream clay, with big shiny friendly eyes and a huge grin, wearing a tiny red marching-band jacket with gold buttons and a drum strapped to his tummy, on a lantern-lit parade street.
bones.style: an excitable, bouncy little drummer, full of energy, laughing a lot

bubbles.head: Mrs. Bubbles: a chatty, round black cauldron with a friendly face on her belly (big kind eyes, rosy cheeks, a smiling mouth) and a little floral headscarf, with glowing green potion bubbling over her rim and sparkles floating up, on a cottage hearth.
bubbles.style: a chatty, cheerful auntie, fast and bubbly, giggling, a little scatterbrained

pip.head: Pip: a tiny, fluffy ghost kitten made of soft white felt, faintly glowing and a little see-through, with big round eyes, a pink nose, little whiskers and a wispy tail, floating among cushions in a cosy attic.
pip.style: a tiny, shy, very young child, squeaky and sweet, trying very hard to be brave

cobweb.head: Grandma Cobweb: a sweet old grandmother spider made of soft grey felt, with eight little legs, round spectacles, a lace shawl and knitting needles, knitting a sparkly silver web in a cosy corner by a window.
cobweb.style: a sweet, slow old granny, warm and gentle, chuckling softly

hoot.head: Sir Hoot: a round, pompous professor owl made of brown and cream felt, with big amber eyes, a tiny monocle, a bow tie and a graduation cap, perched on a stack of old books under a reading lamp.
hoot.style: a pompous, posh professor, very proper and a little full of himself, but kind

scenes.title: Old Man Moon
scenes.line: Ho-hum... hello down there! <chuckle> It's me, Old Man Moon. Tonight is the Hollow Hill Parade, and everyone is coming to say hello. <short pause> Ooh, here they come now... shine on, shine on!

scenes.title: Lantern Larry
scenes.line: Evening, evening! Lantern Larry's the name, and glowing's my game! <short pause> Oh, bother... has anyone seen my hat?! <laugh> Every single Halloween!

scenes.title: Countess Moth
scenes.line: Dahling! <gasp> Is that... a candle? <sigh> Ooh, how dazzling! I simply must flutter closer... <giggle> Countess Moth, at your service. Do mind my wings!

scenes.title: Bartholomew Bones
scenes.line: Ba-dum, ba-dum, ba-dum-dum! <laugh> Bartholomew Bones, the bounciest drummer on Hollow Hill! When I laugh, I rattle-tattle! <laugh> Rattle-tattle-tattle!

scenes.title: Mrs. Bubbles
scenes.line: Ooh, visitors! Come in, come in, the potion's lovely tonight! A pinch of pumpkin, a sprinkle of stars, and a dash of giggles... <giggle> Oops! Pardon me! That was a sparkle burp!

scenes.title: Pip
scenes.line: Mew? <short pause> Mew-boo! <giggle> I'm Pip! I'm the littlest ghost on Hollow Hill, and I'm still learning to be spooky. <short pause> Mew... boo? Did that work?

scenes.title: Grandma Cobweb
scenes.line: Oh, hello, dearie! <chuckle> Grandma Cobweb here, knitting a brand new web for the parade. Knit one, purl spooky... <short pause> knit one, purl spooky. There! Isn't it sparkly?

scenes.title: Sir Hoot
scenes.line: Ahem! Whoo goes there? <short pause> Ah, a trick-or-treater! Sir Hoot, Professor of Night-time Studies. Today's lesson: always say thank you for your treats. Class dismissed!

scenes.title: Old Man Moon
scenes.line: What a parade! <chuckle> Now off you go, little ones, and fill those buckets right up. Happy Halloween from all of us on Hollow Hill! <short pause> Shine on... shine on.
